study_label: de Verteuil 2010 — Primary mouse DC LMP7/MECL1 dKO immunopeptidome

receipts.europepmc_suppl_endpoint: HTTP 200 XML error declining non-OA distribution (not an archive)

access_status.admission_policy: No original quantitative table is fabricated or redistributed; local authorized copies of Supplemental Table S1 can be qualified and converted into explicit contrast recipes via hitlist.dc_immunoproteasome_qualification.

secondary_observed_protein_changes.note: Reduced LMP2/PSMB9 protein is reported alongside LMP7/MECL1 double loss; keep separate from genotype knockouts and do not model as an isolated single-parameter cleavage change.

b2m_control_contract.note: Beta2m-deficient DCs serve as MHC-I IP specificity/background controls, never as ordinary peptide-abundance training negatives.

measurement_and_ascertainment_guards.detection_limit_note: WT/dKO fold-change ratios computed using the reported 15,000 detection limit must be retained as lower-bound inequalities (>=) rather than exact finite ratios or numeric KO zeros.
measurement_and_ascertainment_guards.ascertainment_note: Primary study applied predicted-MHC-motif search filtering (H2-Kb/H2-Db); preserve algorithmic allele assignment as ascertainment metadata distinct from measured single-allele labels and sample repertoire.
